title: Change feed pagination resumes without replay
requirement: A LatestVersion change feed can persist and resume a continuation without losing or replaying changes from the current snapshot.

hostedEmulatorGatewayV1.reason: The hosted emulator validates the public continuation path over a stable snapshot but does not yet retain a complete change log.
